verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal exposes a full API-based integration path (docs-1, docs-18) backed by Stripe's public OpenAPI spec (docs-41), a CLI for building/testing (docs-37), webhooks for event-driven automation (docs-38), and an official MCP server explicitly for AI agents to interact with the Stripe API (docs-35, probe-4). Community evidence corroborates real-world API-level Terminal integrations (comm-1). Missing for 10: an official openapi.json/swagger endpoint directly on docs.stripe.com (probe-3 404s, though the GitHub spec repo exists) and independent hands-on validation of an AI agent specifically driving Terminal via the API/MCP.
